snippet.title: NFSCO - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The definitive Need for Speed: Carbon experience.

Available now on NFSMods! (https://nfsmods.xyz/mod/187)

NFSCO improves the PC version of Electronic Arts' Need for Speed: Carbon all across the board. From improved vanilla vehicle models and textures, to entirely new tracks and heat levels.

The fun doesn't stop there. You can free roam and race online with up to 30 players, host your own servers, play on LAN, and even on the go with a Steam Deck.

We are just getting started. There are big plans for the future, and we would love if you keep sticking around to see them transpire.

Join our Discord server (https://discord.nfsco.club) and Telegram group (https://telegram.nfsco.club) to stay up to date with the project.

Music: Dirty Bird - Cartz.
